# SchreckNet

> SchreckNet is a card search and deck-building tool for the V5 (Fifth
> Edition) format of Vampire: The Eternal Struggle (VTES), a trading card
> game published by Paradox Interactive AB. It hosts exact, regex, and
> semantic search over the full V5-legal card pool (218 crypt cards, 444
> library cards), offline-capable deck building with legality checking,
> and a private, code-gated playgroup game log with a leaderboard.

SchreckNet is unofficial fan content, not affiliated with or endorsed by
Paradox Interactive. Portions of the card data and card text are
copyrights and trademarks of Paradox Interactive AB, used with
permission (see /legal).

## Card reference

- [Precons](/precons): every official V5 preconstructed starter deck,
  grouped by set. Individual card pages are linked from crypt/library
  search results and are reachable at /cards/{id}.

## Tools

- [Crypt search](/crypt) and [Library search](/library): exact, regex,
  and offline semantic search over the V5 card pool.
- [Rules reference](/rules): an interactive VTES V5 turn-structure and
  combat reference derived from the official rules.
- [Decks](/decks): offline deck building with legality checking.

## API

SchreckNet exposes the same card search, card detail, and deck-building
capabilities as the web app through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server
(Streamable HTTP at /mcp) and a mirrored REST API under /api/v1 - see
/help for details.

## Notes for crawlers

- /table and /share/* are intentionally excluded (see /robots.txt):
  both are private, code-gated user data, not general reference content.
- Card text/rulings are sourced from the official VEKN card database and
  KRCG's data export; treat this site's card pages as a mirror of that
  canonical data, not the original source.
